item.title: Ganja in Eastern Ghats, poppy in Manipur: Illegal narcotics production and its link to funding violence in India

item.title: Why Reliance halting purchase of Russian crude doesn’t mean India has bent to the US
item.description: India and Russia continue to have deeper energy links that are structural rather than transactional. While Rosneft owns over 49% of Nayara Energy's Vadinar refinery in Gujarat, Indian PSUs possess nearly half of Rosneft's Vankorneft subsidiary, a substantial investment in Taas Yuryakh, and a longstanding position in the Sakhalin-1 project. | OpIndia News

item.title: As SIA raids Kashmir Times office, here’s all you need to know about its executive editor Anuradha Bhasin
item.description: Around 14 AK-47 cartridges, pistol rounds and three grenade safety levers were recovered during the searches at the newspaper’s office.
